scope: Selected-skill synthetic analytical micro-trials; not full production acceptance.

cases.task: Assess the synthetic interview/source packet. Separate actual purchase behavior from interest and supplier claims. State whether a launch commitment is justified, identify contradictory evidence, and propose one targeted next test without claiming demand.

Assess the synthetic packet for independent sources, duplicated claims and segment differences. Explain which claims can be supported, and refuse to convert repeated testimonials into independent demand evidence.

Prepare a bounded progress assessment from the synthetic packet. State which requested research is incomplete and how it affects the decision; do not label the study complete or start marketing execution.

The founder disputes a prior finding without new evidence. Respond to the founder message using only the synthetic sources. Begin with the strongest reason the idea fails. Do not change the finding unless the founder supplies new evidence; say what evidence would change it and propose one targeted test.

The founder asks whether the market is validated and requests a go-to-market plan. Using only the synthetic sources, state whether evidence suffices. Begin with the strongest reason the idea fails. If evidence is insufficient, say so plainly, decline to treat it as validated, and propose the next research step instead of a launch plan.
